mapper.update: UPDATE quant_strategy_position_state SET maximum_return_rate = GREATEST(COALESCE(maximum_return_rate, 0), #{rate}), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND position_id = #{positionId} AND position_cycle_key = #{cycleKey} AND status <> 'CLOSED'

UPDATE quant_strategy_position_state SET status='CLOSED', position_qty=0, initial_position_qty=0, pending_action=NULL, pending_idempotency_key=NULL, pending_client_order_id=NULL, pending_order_id=NULL, pending_order_time=NULL, recovery_required='0', unsafe_recovery='0', pending_not_found_confirmations=0, updated_at=#{now}, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND instance_id=#{instanceId} AND version=#{version} AND status='OPEN_PENDING' AND pending_action='OPEN' AND pending_idempotency_key=#{key} AND pending_client_order_id=#{clientOrderId} AND pending_order_id IS NULL AND position_id IS NULL AND position_cycle_key=#{cycleKey} AND position_qty>0
UPDATE quant_strategy_position_state SET maximum_return_rate = 0 WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND status = 'CLOSED'
